newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy market still sees lower o/n rates.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy market still sees lower o/n rates.

text.p: Italy's money market continues to expect a fall in the overnight rate on a one-month horizon, a study by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.
The study, based on implicit overnight rates, showed the market saw o/n at 7.52 percent in one month, up from 7.34 percent seen a week ago.
The actual overnight rate stood at 7.75 percent on Thursday, the day in which Igier based its study.
On a three-month time frame, the implicit overnight rate was seen standing at 7.19 percent, only slightly higher than last week's 7.18 percent and 6.99 percent seen one month ago.

On a one-year horizon, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 6.82 percent, lower than the 6.88 percent seen a week ago but higher than last month's 6.20 percent. On a two-year horizon, the implicit o/n rate was seen at 7.32 percent against 7.04 percent seen last week and 6.47 percent last month.

The spread between the German implicit overnight rate and the Italian implicit overnight rate on a two-year timeframe, considered a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union, was at 261 basis points from 245 bps seen a week ago and 212 pbs one month ago.
